title: An inclusion of finite simplicial sets is a chain of one-simplex extensions
statement: Let $U\subseteq V$ be a simplicial subset of a simplicial set [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set], with $U_n$ and $V_n$ finite and nonempty for all $n\geq0$, and assume that $U$ and $V$ have finitely many nondegenerate simplices. Then there is a chain of simplicial subsets $U=W^0\subseteq W^1\subseteq\dots\subseteq W^r=V$ ($r\geq0$) such that for every $0\leq k<r$ there are $n\geq0$ and $x\in W^{k+1}_n$, $x\notin W^k_n$, with (1) $W^{k+1}_i=W^k_i$ for all $i<n$, (2) $W^{k+1}_n=W^k_n\cup\{x\}$, and (3) every $z\in W^{k+1}_j$ with $j>n$ and $z\notin W^k_j$ is degenerate (as a simplex of $W^{k+1}$).
